detail: Read review rubric before source inspection; prohibited sources not opened.
Verified notation semantics: Var is variance, Hyp/Poisson/Binomial macros are labels only.
Verified wrapper imports lecture_07 body and preamble.
Started line-numbered source audit.

Tested stated Poisson-approximation recipe at n=100,p=0.2 (np=20): Bin(100,.2) mass at 20 is 0.0993002148 versus Poi(20) mass 0.0888353174 (10.54% relative error); at 0 the Poisson mass is 10.1184 times the binomial mass.
Verified the Poisson-limit PGF computation: (1+lambda(s-1)/n)^n tends to exp(lambda(s-1)), the Poisson PGF.
Verified thinning joint mass factorizes for j,k nonnegative and the Poisson-only characterization is mathematically valid for 0<p<1, subject to the stated degenerate endpoint exceptions.
Checked plotted thinning radii against the caption: radii (not raw values) scale as square roots of joint masses, so displayed circle areas are consistent with the stated proportionality; no finding.
Completed Poisson limit, approximation, thinning, and accompanying numerical example/figure audit.
Used the admitted parameter N=M=n=1. Then X=1 almost surely and Var(X)=0, while the displayed variance expression contains (N-1)^{-1}=1/0.
Derived PMF by subset counting and moments from draw indicators: Cov(I_r,I_s)=-p(1-p)/(N-1), yielding n p(1-p)(N-n)/(N-1) for N>1.
Checked fixed-n hypergeometric-to-binomial limit by falling-factorial ratios; conditions imply the claimed Bin(n,p) point masses.
Checked marker example/exercise: for Hyp(8,4,3), masses at 0,1,2,3 are 1/14,3/7,3/7,1/14 and sum to 1.
Completed hypergeometric model, PMF, mean/variance, limit supplement, example, and linked exercises audit.
Enumerated two-die categories: displayed joint masses total 36/36 and marginal X=(25,10,1)/36 matches Bin(2,1/6).

The definition declares F_XY only on R^2 but the proposition evaluates it at coordinates infinity. The intended identities are valid as limits in the extended reals, not at points in the declared domain.
Verified joint-CDF factorization criterion (with the notes' strict-inequality convention) and the normal counterexample Z=Y: Cov(X+Y,Y)=1, so the two are not independent.
Completed joint PMF, marginals, die example, joint CDF, independence criterion, and dependence remark audit.

Expanded covariance directly and re-derived both variance-of-sum identities; formulas are correct when the required finite second moments hold. Independence implies zero covariance under the definition's existence condition.

Correlation is defined only for strictly positive variances on lines 413-416, but both landmark theorems quantify over arbitrary finite variances. For a constant X, rho(X,Y) is undefined and the proofs' normalized variables do not exist.

Part-whole correlation formulas omit nondegeneracy: iid constants make the asserted 1/sqrt(2) expression 0/0; thinning p=0 or 1 likewise makes rho(N,X) undefined. Conditional formula also needs an integrable conditional-expectation version and an almost-everywhere/support qualification for exact S_n=t conditioning.
Expanded AR(1) recursion and checked finite-time variance, covariance, and limiting stationary correlation. Statements are correct when 'established regime' means the i->infinity limit.
Completed covariance, correlation, equality criterion, part-whole supplement, and AR(1) audit.
Initial final-ledger patch did not match all coverage contexts; no audit content was modified, so the patch was split and retried.
The proof's stated special case p_n=lambda/n for every n is not a valid Bin(n,p_n) sequence when lambda>1 and n<lambda; only the eventual definition is needed for the limit.
Correlation -1 for fixed N requires 0<p<1, and the finite-population factor is not <1 for the permitted/sample-boundary n=1 (it equals 1; n=0 would make it >1).

All six exercises are mathematically appropriate after inheriting/correcting the documented domains: direct Poisson limit, hypergeometric variance, marker PMF, CDF marginals, covariance expansion, and the normal counterexample.
Did not inspect lecture_07.pdf: source-level review covered every mathematical display and visual numerical claim; PDF rendering was not needed for mathematical verification.
Completed exercises and final full-source audit.
Validated state.json and every findings.jsonl row as JSON; coverage/state contain no pending or in-progress status. Severity count independently matches state: P1=3, P2=4.
